# Weekly status (one page, read in thirty seconds)

Team: AI platform. Week ending: YYYY-MM-DD. Author: a person, not a model.

## Green (one line each, no ask)

- Item: what moved, in one line.

## Yellow and red (one block each)

### Item name (yellow or red)

- What changed: one sentence a stranger could check.
- Ask: what you need, from whom.
- Decision needed: the choice, and the option you recommend.
- Date: when the answer is needed, and what slips after it.

## Numbers (same five every week)

- Cycle time, 85th percentile (days), and last week's value.
- Items finished this week, and work in progress now.
- Open items older than the 85th percentile (list their ids).
- Eval pass rate on the release set, and model spend against budget.
- Incidents opened and closed this week.

Rules: no per-person figures. A yellow item that stays yellow for three weeks becomes a red item with a decision attached.
